title: Diorama Journey

description.en: Miniature 3D storytelling with narration, chapter clips and slides
description.zh: 通过微缩 3D 场景讲故事，生成配音、分章视频与幻灯片

subject: A miniature cream gateway with a terracotta cap, sage island and model trees, stone path and amber lantern

subject.en: Miniature gateway and an amber lantern on a sage model island
subject.zh: 鼠尾草绿微缩岛上的拱门与琥珀灯笼

description.en: The gateway, two trees, stone path and recurring amber lantern come from the original example. The complete miniature is uniformly inset with generous clearance around its octagonal base and terracotta cap.
description.zh: 拱门、两棵树、石径与贯穿故事的琥珀灯笼，来自项目原始示例。完整模型等比内收，让八角底座和陶土色门顶都留有充足净空。

description.en: Cream architectural stone, matte sage surfaces, terracotta and brass give this storytelling skill a physical tool identity. Its continuous 3D volume and native material colors are preserved through transparent extraction.
description.zh: 奶油色建筑石材、哑光鼠尾草绿表面、陶土和黄铜，为叙事技能建立实体工具形象。透明提取保留连续的三维体积与原生材质颜色。

title.en: Chapter gates on a working sheet

description.en: Pressed arch construction lines, paired registration ticks and a turning chapter route sit on sage model-making paper. The separate surface connects miniature scene construction with a continuous story timeline.
description.zh: 鼠尾草绿模型纸上压印拱门施工线、成对定位刻度与转折的章节路线，把微缩场景搭建和连续叙事时间线联系起来。

source.description: Miniature 3D storytelling with narration, chapter clips and slides

goal.en: Turn source material into an original narrated miniature 3D journey. A recurring element connects the chapters; the same timeline produces a full film, chapter MP4 clips, subtitles and PPTX/PDF/ODP slides with speaker notes. Install the skill to create an independent project from its starter.
goal.zh: 把原始材料转成原创的配音微缩 3D 旅程，以一个贯穿元素连接各个章节。同一条时间线导出完整影片、分章 MP4、字幕，以及带演讲备注的 PPTX/PDF/ODP 幻灯片。安装技能后，可从 starter 创建独立项目。

role.en: Reusable starter and a browser viewer for chapters and downloads
role.zh: 可复用 starter，以及用于章节浏览和下载的网页播放器

role.en: Miniature 3D worlds, camera choreography and frame-based film rendering
role.zh: 微缩 3D 世界、镜头编排与逐帧影片渲染

role.en: Narration, captions, chapter clips and matching presentation exports
role.zh: 配音、字幕、分章视频与配套演示文稿导出

alt.en: Miniature gateway and an amber lantern on a sage model island on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 鼠尾草绿微缩岛上的拱门与琥珀灯笼，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: One little light. A whole journey.
caption.zh: 一点灯光，串起一段旅程。

description.en: A miniature gateway and amber lantern for stories told through connected 3D worlds.
description.zh: 以微缩拱门和琥珀灯笼，呈现相互连接的 3D 叙事世界。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥164px wide; lockup ≥180px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine material detail softens at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 164px，组合至少 180px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小材质细节会柔化。

alt.en: The original miniature story example, with an amber lantern, cream gateway and connected chapter scenes.
alt.zh: 原始微缩叙事示例，包含琥珀灯笼、奶油色拱门与相互连接的章节场景。
